title: Default audit lineage is scoped to one session

context.hint: Review isolation of default event identifiers and audit-chain state on a shared tool server.
context.surface: A tool server can serve several client sessions in one process. Event logging assigns default session identifiers and links events to prior events.
assumptions: Multiple client sessions can share one server process.
Tests can use in-memory client and server streams with synthetic events.

review.invariant: Each client session owns its default event identifiers and parent links. The first event of a new session starts an independent chain.
review.verification: Connect two local fixture sessions to one server. Assert distinct default identifiers and independent first events. As a control, verify that subsequent events in a single session retain their chain.

source_observation.summary: Direct fixture calls and connected in-memory clients showed that the original implementation shared a default identifier and audit lineage across client sessions. The repaired fixture produced independent chains.
